versions.changelog:
Initial release of infinimo-ai-design-product-video-create — generate handheld, avatar-led product videos using Infinimo AI Design.

- Guides users through a 3-step workflow: select avatar and product, generate first-frame, and produce shoppable video.
- Supports AI script generation, image-to-video creation, and polling for results.
- WebSocket updates for first-frame and video status.
- Designed for fast shoppable shorts, product demos, and listing promo videos.
- Provides CLI script examples for all endpoints and required parameters.
